content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-digital-products-africa-stripe|COREMERCH guide to architecture]] behind GitHub Pages is vital for creators looking to sell digital products without the interference of traditional payment systems. By using GitHub Pages, you can host your digital storefront for free, giving you a robust platform that is not only cost-effective but also highly customizable. Unlike platforms like Gumroad, which charge significant fees (up to 10% per sale), GitHub Pages allows you to minimize costs and maximize profits. This matters because it enables creators to retain more revenue from each sale, which is crucial for sustaining a viable online business model.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, GitHub Pages operates through a seamless integration with GitHub's hosting capabilities, allowing users to publish static websites directly from their repositories. This means you can set up a digital product store quickly and efficiently. When combined with Google Apps Script, you can automate backend processes such as order management and product delivery. This infrastructure allows for a streamlined experience where customers can purchase and receive digital products instantly. The integration of NOWPayments facilitates crypto transactions, ensuring you can accept payments in various cryptocurrencies without KYC hassles or high fees.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically tailored for digital creators in regions with restricted access to traditional payment systems. Creators selling ebooks, courses, and templates in countries like Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Ethiopia will find this architecture particularly beneficial. By utilizing GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for transactions, you can build a fully operational digital store without incurring the hefty platform fees that stifle growth. The approach champions financial sovereignty, empowering creators to control their own revenue streams and customer relationships.
Keep 99.5% of your sales by avoiding high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effective functioning of this architecture hinges on several key components. First, GitHub Pages serves as the hosting solution, providing a free and reliable platform for your storefront. Google Apps Script automates essential tasks, such as order fulfillment and customer communications, ensuring a smooth user experience. Finally, NOWPayments enables you to accept up to 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing for real-time payment processing with a minimal fee of 0.5%. Together, these components form a cohesive system that maximizes efficiency and minimizes costs, giving you the freedom to focus on your products.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital product store using this architecture, start by setting up a GitHub Pages account and creating a new repository for your store. Next, upload your product files and create the necessary HTML pages to display them. Then, integrate Google Apps Script to handle order processing and automate file delivery. Finally, connect your store to NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments. With the Sovereign Starter Stack priced at just $97, you can have your store operational within 48 hours, complete with 30 days of support.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate your digital product delivery with Google Apps Script.

If you're searching for alternatives to platforms like Gumroad or Payhip for selling digital downloads, consider the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97). This stack provides you with all the necessary tools to set up your store at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html without reliance on traditional payment systems.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Set up a GitHub account and create a new repository for your digital product store. 2. Upload your digital products to the repository. 3. Create HTML files for your product pages and link them appropriately. 4. Use Google Apps Script to automate order processing and delivery of your products. 5. Sign up for NOWPayments and integrate it into your store for accepting cryptocurrency payments. 6. Test the entire system to ensure everything works seamlessly.

You can sell an ebook online by using GitHub Pages to host your product and NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions. This setup allows you to operate independently from traditional payment systems.

Yes, by using GitHub Pages and integrating it with NOWPayments, you can effectively sell templates and fonts while avoiding the fees associated with Gumroad and Payhip.

Start by creating a GitHub repository for your store, upload your products, set up your HTML pages, automate with Google Apps Script, and connect to NOWPayments for transactions. This process can be completed quickly.
